notes.title: Cinematic horror Retrieval shows off bloody delights in new trailer
notes.notes:
Honestly it's beginning to seem like going to another planet is simply a bad idea. You can be a space explorer having a lovely time out there and then bam, you're on a world like Ryhalian and things are going very wrong indeed. That's exactly what's happening to your character in upcoming horror game Retrieval, and in its newest trailer you can get a taste of the action - if your stomach is strong enough.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Retrieval - Official 2024 Gamescom Reveal Trailer
notes.notes:
[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/de46a0_3b38f4c909b846c9af60add22ba8ccab~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_925,h_520,al_c,q_90,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/de46a0_3b38f4c909b846c9af60add22ba8ccab~mv2.png[/img]

We are excited to announce that Retrieval, a new cinematic horror adventure, will be released on PC and consoles. A rich blend of immersive storytelling, gripping gameplay and deep character development, Retrieval is available to wishlist now on Steam and the Playstation Store. 


To celebrate the announcement the studio has released a brand new trailer that premiered at the Future Game Show.  The trailer showcases an exclusive look at real-time footage captured with RTXDI®, an NVIDIA technology that significantly improves ray-traced shadows and reflections. Additionally, it features fully 3D audio using Dolby Atmos® technology, with sound designed by Wild Cat Records.

The trailer can be viewed here:
[previewyoutube=QZ2NXIEu1JE;full][/previewyoutube]

This award-winning title invites players to step into the shoes of Hana Loshe, the courageous commander of a research team stranded on the distant planet Ryhalian. Set in a mysterious retro-futuristic base, players will navigate through a ravaged world in a bid to survive, facing relentless challenges and terrifying adversaries at every turn.

[img]https://static.wixstatic.com/media/de46a0_e968acea8b5c4efea7b891784ea04ebc~mv2.jpg/v1/fill/w_925,h_388,al_c,q_80,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01,enc_auto/de46a0_e968acea8b5c4efea7b891784ea04ebc~mv2.jpg[/img]

Retrieval offers a gripping narrative filled with unexpected twists, delving into themes of friendship, love, loyalty, and horror.  The game's rich character development and compelling storytelling will captivate players as they uncover the chilling secrets of Ryhalian.

With its atmospheric visuals powered by NVIDIA and haunting 3D sound design, 

Players will embark on this perilous journey with Hana Loshe and experience the intense drama and thrilling gameplay in this survival horror adventure that blurs the lines between cinema and gaming. 

Retrieval is available to wishlist now on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2999120/Retrieval/]Steam[/url] and the [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011723]Playstation Store[/url] now with Xbox to follow. 

For more information please visit: [url=https://www.333-studios.com/retrieval/]https://www.333-studios.com/retrieval/[/url]
